title: Position cutting die and cut leather
setting: Footwear factory, standing at a clicker press
masks_caveat: the leather strip and the piece cut from it are not outlined; the die's outline is lost under the press head during the cut (4.0–6.0 s). The press handle (the red ball on the lever) is outlined only where it was found reliably: 3.9–4.3 s, 4.9–5.7 s and briefly near the end. The left hand is not outlined while it is out of view or blurred, 3.4–4.9 s and 6.1–6.6 s.
contact_roles: the right hand sets the die on the leather strip, holds it while it is lined up, and later lifts it off and holds it; the left hand smooths the strip, swings the press and pulls its handle, then pulls the cut piece out of the die at 10.2–10.5 s and tosses it aside. The leather strip lies on the cutting board, so a hand on the strip reads as touching the cutting board; the cut piece is not an outlined object, so the hand carrying and tossing it reads as free. The press head is not one of the outlined objects either, so a hand swinging or pushing it reads as free. Parts of this clip's contact were corrected by a reviewer watching the video, where the automatic cues missed it (those frames are marked as reviewer-corrected in the data).
